entities.name: Indian Caste System (Varna)
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The Rigveda describes four varnas: Brahmins (priests), Kshatriyas (warriors), Vaishyas (merchants), Shudras (laborers). Below all were the "untouchables" (Dalits). Caste determined occupation, marriage partners, diet, and social contact. Violation meant severe social punishment or ostracism.
